# Turku fixtures

Recorded from the public JSON API of paatokset.turku.fi on 2026-11-15 (public documents), from a
home connection: the cloud build environment could not reach the host. Trimmed:

- `poytakirja-5481565.json`: council 26.10.2026 minutes, items § 183, § 185, § 186 (two votes,
  case history from Kh § 315 and § 330) and § 194 (an initiative), plus the appeal instructions.
- `poytakirja-5492916.json`: council 16.11.2026 agenda, three items.
- `lasnaolotiedot-5481565.json`: attendance with the occupation field (`nimike`) blanked.
- `liitteet-5481535.json`: attachments of § 186.
- `vote-2531451.pdf`: "Äänestyslistat" of § 186 (two votes, 67 voters with party).
- `toimielimet.json`, `paatosvuodet-Kv.json`, `toimielin-Kv-{2025,2026}.json`: bodies and listings.

The distribution lists ("Jakelu") at the end of each item's html are cut.
